items.title: MindMaze (Encarta browser recreation)
items.controls: An author-hosted recreation of Encarta 98's MindMaze. Use the game's mouse or touch controls to explore rooms and answer questions. Embedded play uses Tourist mode without saved names or progress. Open full page for the creator's player profiles. Closing or leaving ends this session.
items.license: Hosted by its creator; Encarta assets are not copied into this project

items.title: DOS Defender
items.controls: Move the mouse to steer. Hold the left mouse button to fire. Right-click after game over to restart.
items.license: Unlicense

items.title: Master Mind (1999)
items.controls: Use the mouse to choose a menu option and build guesses from colored pins. White and black dots give feedback on your guess.
items.license: CC0

items.title: Zmiy Snake
items.controls: Use the arrow keys to steer the snake. Enter or P pauses the game. Escape quits to DOS.
items.license: BSD-2-Clause

items.title: SkiFree (browser remake)
items.controls: Press Resume or Start to ski. Use Left and Right arrows or the mouse to steer, Down to tuck, Space to jump, and F for fast mode. Dodge trees and rocks, pass gates, and escape the chasing monster. Touch controls work on phones.
items.license: MIT

items.title: Retro Vault (26 games)
items.controls: Browse all 26 games in one cabinet. Touch controls, keyboard (arrows/WASD, Space/Enter and X), or a Bluetooth/USB gamepad with remappable A, B and Start buttons. Progress is saved on this device.
items.license: Original browser implementations; no third-party game binaries or ROMs
